optimizedCVData.summary: Communications graduate with hands-on experience in social media management, content production, and audience growth across Instagram, TikTok, and email channels. Built and managed the full content calendar for a local retailer and a student film society, growing a newsletter audience from 640 to 1,150 subscribers and increasing event attendance through targeted organic campaigns. Comfortable working across multiple content formats and platforms, with foundational skills in analytics and a strong interest in brand storytelling and audience engagement. Eager to bring creative and organizational energy to a fast-moving marketing team.

bullets: Grew the email newsletter audience from 640 to 1,150 subscribers over the summer by designing and placing a sign-up QR code at the point of sale.
Produced and scheduled content consistently across Instagram and email, maintaining a cadence of one newsletter per week alongside regular social posts.
Contributed to the planning and on-site coordination of a weekend pet adoption event, supporting logistics and visitor engagement.
Drafted all social copy and email content independently, adapting tone and format to suit each channel and audience segment.
Managed the society's Instagram and TikTok accounts end-to-end, covering content creation, scheduling, and community engagement across a three-year tenure.
Increased average screening attendance from 35 to 60 tickets per event by introducing a weekly short-form video series highlighting upcoming films.
Recruited, onboarded, and trained two volunteer content creators, establishing a repeatable workflow for content production.

highlights: Thesis: How short-form video changes brand recall among 18 to 24 year olds, based on a survey of 212 students.

analysis.summary: Maya is an early-career candidate whose documented experience is centered on social media content, newsletter management, and a single event contribution — with very limited overlap with the experiential marketing and event logistics requirements of this Coinbase role. The optimization strategy focuses on surfacing every verified transferable skill (content production, audience engagement, analytics) prominently while strictly excluding the many required skills not found in her source documents.
key_changes: Repositioned headline to highlight Communications, Content Strategy, and Social Media — the areas where Maya has genuine documented experience — rather than overstating event management credentials she does not have.

Surfaced the verified newsletter growth metric (640 to 1,150 subscribers) and the ticket sales improvement (35 to 60 per event) as the strongest quantified achievements in the CV, since these are the only verified metrics available.
Dropped the Barista role entirely as it is irrelevant to a marketing role at Coinbase and would consume space better used for the two marketing-relevant entries.

Grouped skills into clean, accurate categories using only tools explicitly named in the source CV: content tools (Canva, CapCut, Photoshop), channels (Instagram, TikTok, Mailchimp, Hootsuite), and analytics (Google Analytics, Instagram Insights, Excel).
Preserved the adoption event contribution from the internship as a genuine, if limited, event-adjacent experience — described accurately without inflating it into full event management ownership.
Noted the significant gap between this role's requirements and Maya's current experience level in the ATS compatibility score; no missing skills were added to protect her credibility in interviews.

Growing a newsletter list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers in a single summer taught me that the best audience-building happens when you meet people in the right moment, and Coinbase's work bringing high-impact experiences to both Consumer and Institutional audiences is exactly that kind of intentional connection at scale.

My background is in content and community rather than formal event logistics, but the underlying work overlaps more than the titles suggest. Coordinating a weekend adoption event that drew around 300 visitors, managing weekly content calendars across Instagram and TikTok, and tracking performance through Instagram Insights and Excel all required the same discipline that event execution demands: clear timelines, attention to detail, and the ability to keep multiple moving pieces on track simultaneously. I also bring strong copywriting and Canva skills that would support creative development for invitations, signage, and branded materials, areas the role involves directly.

I would welcome the chance to talk through how my background translates to Coinbase's experiential marketing calendar, and I am available for a conversation at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Maya Linden
